_comment: Brand configuration. Addendum A.3 / A.13. Ferrari is the first implementation, not a hard-coded assumption. Secrets are never stored here - only the NAME of the environment variable holding them.

ferrari.corpus_status_note: Beta candidate. The expanded 16-document corpus is prepared LOCALLY and is NOT deployed: it has not been ingested to or uploaded into the live production vector store, which is unchanged and still serves the existing 330 GTC/GTS beta. NOT the Ferrari Judging Committee approved production corpus - per Addendum A.8, the Committee provides and approves the production set.

_comment: STANDALONE TEST BRAND — Batch 1 corpus. Not served by the application.
All three Netlify functions call corpus('ferrari') explicitly, and netlify.toml
bundles build/ferrari/* by name, so nothing under this key can reach the live site.
It exists so ingestion and retrieval can be exercised against a larger corpus
without touching the production vector store or the frozen production artifacts.
ferrari-test.corpus_dir_note: Supply with --corpus-dir. The Batch 1 PDFs live outside the repository so they never enter git or the Netlify build.
ferrari-test.corpus_status_note: Batch 1 test corpus. NOT approved for production deployment. Ferrari Judging Committee confirmation pending.
